hero.company: Chengdu Berry Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.
hero.tagline: Ultra-Precision Optical Components & Specialty Optoelectronic Instruments
hero.subtitle: Founded in 2001, a renowned Chinese brand in picometer optical element manufacturing, specializing in ultra-precision optical components and specialty optoelectronic detection instruments, widely used in AI optical communications, aerospace, semiconductor, laser, and large scientific facilities.

research.title: R&D Center
research.desc: Chengdu Berry Modern Optoelectronics Engineering Technology Research Center, Academician (Expert) Innovation Workstation, and Ultra-Smooth Polishing Technology Laboratory, establishing high-end technology and industrial cooperation platforms at home and abroad.

inspection.title: Inspection Center
inspection.desc: Equipped with precision digital display projectors, ZYGO digital flat interferometers, spectrophotometers, roughness profilometers, and a professional inspection team to guarantee technology R&D and product production.

production.title: Production Center
production.desc: A complete set of optical processing production lines including milling, fine grinding, polishing, edging, inspection, and cementing, plus workshops dedicated to ultra-smooth polishing, meeting various customized customer needs.

cooperation.title: Global Cooperation
cooperation.subtitle: Long-term cooperation with European and American optoelectronics leaders, domestic research institutes, CASC, and CASIC
